assertions.name: the_three_forms_agree
assertions.note: w_k = 1/(q^2k+1) = 1/(1 + (b_pp/b_nn)^(k/2)). So k/2 is LITERALLY the power of the bond ratio the average is weighted by. Lean: weight_eq_inv_rpow

assertions.name: the_interface_closed_form_is_exact
assertions.note: one expression covering AM (k=0), GM (k=1) and HM (k=2). Lean: interface_closed_form

assertions.name: k_maps_to_two_minus_k_inverts_about_the_loop_value
assertions.note: f(k).f(2-k) = 1/[2]_q^2 = 0.2472978867480346 for every k. That is WHY delta is odd about k = 1, and why k = 1 -- the only fixed point -- is where it vanishes. Lean: interface_reflection

assertions.name: the_flavour_split_pushes_k_negative_away_from_the_SEMF_region
assertions.note: k_corpus = -0.006592397579. The corpus's ONE bar-breaking ingredient moves it further from k > 1, not toward it -- and by 1/151 of what the sign needs anyway

assertions.name: no_member_of_the_SEMF_region_has_an_argument
assertions.note: k = 0 (derived, wrong sign) and k = 1 (derived, zero) are the only members with arguments. k = 2 gives the SEMF sign and has none -- NOT adopted on that basis

parameters.note: k is NOT derived; the result is the ENUMERATION -- only k = 0 and k = 1 have arguments and neither gives the SEMF sign. Nothing wired.
